claim: A parameterized physics-informed neural network that learns a latent space can significantly reduce energy consumption in training for many equations compared to training separate models for each coefficient instance.
falsifier: Measure the total energy consumed during training of a parameterized physics-informed neural network with latent space versus training individual models for each coefficient instance on a set of parameterized PDEs.

conditions: the alternative is training separate models for each coefficient instance
exclusions: Evidence is limited to the reported P2INN approach and the specific equations tested; the energy reduction may depend on the number of coefficient instances and model size.

title: Using a parameterized architecture for reduction in energy consumption
